ready: Ready. Double-click a pattern to insert it at the editor time.
needName: Type a name for the pattern first.
needSelect: Select a pattern in the list first.
overwriteQ: A pattern named "{0}" already exists. Overwrite it?
skipped: ({0} file(s) skipped: not a pattern or already in the library.)
importNone: No pattern to import. Only .osu files with hit objects can be added.
exportFolder: Choose a folder for the {0} pattern files
packsFail: Could not reach the packs (check your internet connection). ({0})
shareBody: I'd like to add this pattern to the community pack. (Once approved, everyone can download it from Packs.)
shareOpened: GitHub opened in your browser: press "Create" / "Submit new issue". Once approved it goes into the Community pack.
shareCopied: Pattern copied. Paste it (Ctrl+V) in the marked place on the page that opened, then submit.
botNeedLogin: Save the bot account's username and IRC password first.
botOnline: The bot is connected to osu! chat.
botNoServer: Could not reach the osu! chat server (irc.ppy.sh). Your internet or firewall may block port 6667.
botNoAnswer: The osu! server did not answer the login.
botClosed: The osu! server closed the connection.
botTestMsg: Test message: the bot works. If you see this, reply with !link {0}.
botTestSent: Test message sent to {0}. Check if it arrives in osu!.
botBadLogin: The bot could not log in: wrong username or IRC password.
botLinked: Your account is linked! Type !help for commands.
botBadCode: Wrong code. Send the code shown in the program's Bot window.
botNotLinked: Link your account first: type !link <code> with the code from the program's Bot window.
botUnknown: No category or command named "{0}". Type !help.
patternEmpty: The pattern file has no hit objects.
nameTaken: There is already a pattern named "{0}" in this category.
noSelection: Nothing is selected. Select the pattern's objects in the editor first.
adaptedNoBpm: (The pattern had no BPM: notes were snapped to the nearest 1/4 - 1/3 tick.)
undoneN: Undid "{0}" ({1} objects removed; your later changes are kept).
insertHint: Enter: insert · ↑↓: choose · "tech 1" works too · Ctrl+Tab: switch tab · Esc: close
noPatterns: No patterns yet. Select objects and save them in the Save tab first.
hotkeyFail: The hotkey could not be started. Close and reopen the program.
hotkeySet: Hotkey set to {0}. In the editor, {0} opens saving if objects are selected, otherwise inserting.
editorNotOpen: The osu! editor is not open. Open your beatmap in the editor and try again.
readFail:
Could not read the osu! editor. Try again in a second.
({0})
bPassHelp: Get the IRC password while logged in as the bot account: osu.ppy.sh → Account settings → Legacy API → IRC (not the normal password). It is stored only on this computer, encrypted.
bPassKeep: (saved, type a new one to change it)
bAuto: Start the bot when the program opens
bLinkHow: In osu!, send the bot a private message: !link {0}
bTestHelp: Type your own osu! name: the bot messages you. If it arrives, reply to it with !link and the code.
bWarn: Note: using an account as a bot without osu! approval can get that account restricted. Keep testing light.
share: Share with the community (needs a GitHub account)
pkSub: Downloaded packs are added to your library with their own categories.
adaptTip: When on, the pattern is fitted to the beatmap's BPM and slider velocity: a 1/4 stream stays 1/4, a 1/2 slider stays 1/2 long.
expTip: Saves the selected pattern(s) as .osu files (5 patterns = 5 files). Hold Ctrl and click to select several (Ctrl+A: all).
selN: {0} patterns selected. Press ⤓ to export them.
replaceTip: When on, old objects in the pattern's time range are removed and replaced by the pattern.
dropBig: Drop to add to your library
dropAll: Will be added without a category (you can pick one first)
hkTip: Hotkey (in the editor): with objects selected it opens saving, otherwise searching and inserting a pattern. Click to change it.
hkHelp: Press the new hotkey (can be combined with Ctrl/Alt/Shift). Esc to cancel.
mapNoneSub: Open your beatmap in the osu! editor
empty:
No patterns yet.
Select objects in the editor, type a name above and click Save selected.
botLangSet: OK, I will talk to you in English. (Other languages: !lang <code>)
qHint: Double-click or Enter: insert · you can type "jumps 1" · arrow keys: choose · Esc or F11: close
srvNone: The bot server address is not published yet.
srvNoConn: Could not reach the bot server.
srvClosed: The bot server closed the connection.
botOffline: Your Pattern Gallery program is not running. Open it and try again.
botBusy: The program did not answer in time. Is the osu! editor open?
bLinkHowSrv: In osu!, send {1} a private message: !link {0}
bSrvHelp: Keep the program open while you map, and write the commands to {0} in osu! chat.
